pilot.evaluation_protocol: full ranking over all items not in the user's training set; Recall@20, NDCG@20
pilot.negative_source: implicit: all items the user has not interacted with in train
pilot.notes: [P2] reported Amazon 2023 five-cores only; this is a different source and threshold
pilot.rule_found_in_code_or_release: iterated 10-core on distinct (user, location) check-in pairs reproduces the users exactly (29858) and items to within 7 (40988 vs 40981; pairs 1027464 vs 1027370); one released user has 9 interactions
pilot.rule_stated_in_paper: 'we use the 10-core setting, i.e., retaining users and items with at least ten interactions'
pilot.sources_checked: Wang et al. 2019 SIGIR (NGCF, Sec. 4.1.1); He et al. 2020 SIGIR (LightGCN, Sec. 4); kuandeng/LightGCN Data/gowalla (train, test, user_list, item_list); SNAP loc-gowalla_totalCheckins
pilot.verification: Jaccard users 1.0000, items 0.9998, pairs 0.9999 against the raw 10-core; every release interaction is a raw pair; not exact: 7 core items absent and one released user below the threshold, cause not established (agrees with the independent audit in RECOMMENDATION_AUDIT.md)
